description: DiSCPROFiL connects authorized HR users to their DiSCPROFiL organization data in ChatGPT. Users can find people and role profiles, review DISC results, compare individuals, assess person–role fit, and generate interview, development, and team guidance. The plugin is read-only and supports HR decision-making without making final employment decisions.
